# `hk util check-executables-have-shebangs`

- **Usage:** `hk util check-executables-have-shebangs <FILES>…`
- **Effect:** read-only

Check that executable files have shebangs

## Arguments

- **`<FILES>…`** — Files to check

## Flags

- **`-h --help`** — Print help

<!-- hk documentation examples -->

## Examples

Check an executable script's shebang.

```sh
hk util check-executables-have-shebangs scripts/check.sh
```
